BrochureContent.Content:
Live an enviable coastal lifestyle at Holywell, a well established development host to large imposing family homes. Number 24 is a fine detached family home in excellent decorative condition and comes to the market occupying a prime corner site within a cul de sac area which adjoins a communal lawned area. The west facing rear garden is a great size, lovely and private with an unusually spacious front driveway providing parking for numerous cars.

Holywell, a modern estate of imposing family homes is located on Sea Road, just on the outskirts of Kilcoole. Location is excellent here as one can walk to the never ending Kilcoole beach and the village itself. Public transport links within close proximity include Kilcoole train station, city bound bus links and Greystones Dart station.

On viewing the property, one will note generous room proportions and the overall infusions of light in each room. The accommodation briefly comprises of a welcoming and roomy hallway, generously sized downstairs w/c, large living room to the front with double doors through to an equally spacious dining room. There is a modern kitchen/breakfast room with breakfast bar and the west facing rear garden is private and well maintained. There are four bedrooms upstairs with master ensuite and family bathroom.

The village of Kilcoole itself has an array of local shops to choose from and a Tesco Express. Greystones town is a short distance away and offers an eclectic array of boutiques, eateries and public amenities. There is a national school in Kilcoole village in addition to a well reputed secondary school - both of which are currently undergoing expansion. Numerous sporting clubs exist within the vicinity.

Choosing to purchase a home and lay down roots in Kilcoole may prove to be a very wise decision as the Dart is planned to extend to Kilcoole.

DIRECTIONS
Heading south on the N11, at junction 11 take exit at R774 towards Greystones/Kilcoole/Kilpedder. At roundabout take the 2nd exit and stay on R774. At next roundabout take the 3rd exit onto Kilcoole Road and at next set of lights take 1st exit left onto Sea Road. Take 2nd turn right into Holywell and first turn right once in the development. Continue straight down to the end of the road and property is last house on the corner.
